datasets.title: Fertiliser use, production and trade by country
datasets.description: Agricultural use per hectare of cropland, use, production, imports and exports of nitrogen (N), phosphate (P2O5) and potash (K2O), latest year 2020 to 2024 (FAOSTAT), and net imports as a share of use.

datasets.title: Fertiliser, gas and grain prices, monthly
datasets.description: World Bank Pink Sheet, nominal US dollars a tonne (gas: $/mmbtu), January 1960 to 2026-10, with the World Bank fertiliser and food price indices (2010 = 100).

datasets.title: World Bank fertiliser price forecasts
datasets.description: Annual averages for 2024 and 2025 and forecasts for 2026 to 2028 from the October 2026 Commodity Markets Outlook, with the April 2026 forecasts.

datasets.title: World fertiliser production, use and exports
datasets.description: Million tonnes of nutrient and kg per hectare of cropland, 1961 to 2024 (FAOSTAT).

datasets.title: Fertiliser use per hectare by region
datasets.description: Kg of nutrient per hectare of cropland, 1961 to 2024, by continent and for the least developed countries (FAOSTAT).

datasets.title: Top producers and exporters by nutrient
datasets.description: The ten largest producers and exporters of nitrogen, phosphate and potash fertilisers in 2024, with shares of the world total (FAOSTAT).

datasets.title: Gulf states' fertiliser exports
datasets.description: Exports of Bahrain, Iran, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates in 2024, thousand tonnes of nutrient and share of world exports (FAOSTAT).

datasets.title: UK fertiliser and wheat price indices, monthly
datasets.description: Defra agricultural price indices, 2020 = 100, January 2014 to 2026-08.

datasets.title: Fertiliser application rates in Great Britain
datasets.description: Overall rates, kg of nutrient per hectare, 1992 to 2025, for tillage crops, grassland and both (British Survey of Fertiliser Practice).

datasets.title: Map classes
datasets.description: Bands used to colour the two maps.

datasets.title: Headline findings
datasets.description: Figures quoted from the World Bank, Defra and Al Jazeera.
